stories.title: Abgeordnetenhaus-Wahl: Prien warnt SPD und Grüne vor Regierung mit Linken in Berlin

en.title: State Parliament Election: Prien warns SPD and Greens against government with Left party in Berlin
en.summary: A politician named Prien has cautioned the SPD and Greens against forming a government that includes the Left party in Berlin state politics.

stories.title: Liveblog Ukrainekrieg: Selenskyj: Ukraine bereit zu Teilwaffenruhe für Angriffe auf Energieanlagen

en.title: Ukraine war liveblog: Zelenskyy says Ukraine ready for partial ceasefire on energy infrastructure attacks
en.summary: Ukraine's president indicates willingness to accept a limited ceasefire regarding attacks on energy facilities, while the Kremlin rejects the proposal and reports supply shortages in Russian-controlled areas.

stories.title: Krieg gegen die Ukraine: Selenskyj und Trump diskutieren Stopp von Angriffen auf Energieanlagen

en.title: War against Ukraine: Zelenskyy and Trump discuss halt to attacks on energy infrastructure
en.summary: The Ukrainian president and Trump held discussions at the UN General Assembly about ending the war, including potential talks with Putin and stopping attacks on energy facilities.

stories.title: Leizen: Verdacht auf giftiges Quecksilber – DHL-Zentrum evakuiert

en.title: Leizen: Suspected toxic mercury – DHL distribution center evacuated
en.summary: A DHL package facility in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern was evacuated after a delivery worker reported physical symptoms, with suspected mercury poisoning occurring following a similar incident in the region weeks earlier.

stories.title: Notfälle: Zwei Weltkriegsbomben in Wiesbaden gesprengt

en.title: Emergencies: Two World War bombs detonated in Wiesbaden
en.summary: Two World War-era bombs were detonated in Wiesbaden as part of emergency operations.

stories.title: Ukraine-Krieg: EU hebt Sanktionen gegen zwei russische Milliardäre auf

en.title: Ukraine war: EU lifts sanctions against two Russian billionaires
en.summary: The EU removed sanctions against Russian oligarchs Alisher Usmanov and Mikhail Fridman, a decision Ukraine criticized as unjustifiable.

stories.title: Olympia-Bewerbung: München besser bewertet als Köln und Berlin

en.title: Olympic bid: Munich rated better than Cologne and Berlin
en.summary: An evaluation commission assessed three German cities for an Olympic bid, with Munich receiving the highest rating and Berlin performing significantly worse than the others.

stories.title: Grönland, USA und Dänemark unterzeichnen Sicherheitsabkommen

en.title: Greenland, USA and Denmark sign security agreement
en.summary: The United States, Denmark, and Greenland have concluded a security agreement addressing their shared interests in the Arctic region. The three parties signed the accord during the UN General Assembly in New York.

stories.title: Zweieinhalb Jahre Haft für österreichischen Investor Benko

en.title: Austrian investor Benko sentenced to two and a half years in prison
en.summary: Austrian investor Benko received an increased prison sentence of two and a half years after his conviction was reopened. The sentencing related to damages caused to creditors, with rental advance payments playing a decisive role.

stories.title: Urteil: Zweieinhalb Jahre Haft für René Benko

en.title: Verdict: Two and a half years imprisonment for René Benko
en.summary: A court sentenced Tyrolean entrepreneur René Benko to two and a half years in prison for deliberately paying 360,000 euros in advance rent while apparently insolvent, thereby harming creditors.

stories.title: René Benko in neuem Verfahren zu zweieinhalb Jahren Haft verurteilt

en.title: René Benko sentenced to two and a half years in prison in new trial
en.summary: Austrian investor René Benko was convicted again for damaging creditors, with his sentence increased by six months compared to a previous ruling.

stories.title: Krieg gegen die Ukraine: Tote bei russischen Angriffen auf Industriestädte

en.title: War against Ukraine: Deaths in Russian attacks on industrial cities
en.summary: Russian attacks on Ukrainian industrial cities killed at least four people. Russia reported defending against nearly 300 drones during overnight operations.

stories.title: +++ Iran-Krieg +++: Trump: US-Vertreter haben sich mit Iranern getroffen

en.title: Iran conflict: Trump says US representatives met with Iranians
en.summary: United States representatives met with Iranian officials amid escalating tensions. Iran indicated it would consider opening the Strait of Hormuz under certain conditions during UN discussions.

stories.title: UN-Vollversammlung: Britischer Premier Burnham sucht Annäherung an USA und Europa

en.title: UN General Assembly: British Prime Minister Burnham seeks rapprochement with USA and Europe
en.summary: Britain's prime minister aims to strengthen ties with Washington while advocating for eased trade terms with the EU and establishing global artificial intelligence regulations.

stories.title: Bundesregierung: Reformen durchziehen oder aufweichen? Union streitet um ihren Kurs

en.title: German Government: Push through reforms or water them down? Union divided over its course
en.summary: Following electoral losses, CDU and CSU members are questioning the government's direction, with party leader Merz planning internal discussions. Two distinct factions are already emerging within the party over policy strategy.

stories.title: UN-Vollversammlung: Trump droht Iran erneut mit der Hölle – und nennt KI jetzt anders

en.title: UN General Assembly: Trump threatens Iran again with hell – and now calls AI something else
en.summary: The US president promised an Iran deal following midterm elections in his UN address. He dismissed concerns about artificial intelligence risks as false and proposed replacing the term AI with different terminology.

stories.title: Banken: Volksbanken prüfen nach Stützungsfällen Haftung von Ex-Vorständen

en.title: Banks: Savings banks examine liability of former board members after support cases
en.summary: Several cooperative banks facing financial difficulties are leading investigations into potential damages claims against former managers, according to reporting.
